item.title: Crocs' new campaign celebrates the joy of being unordinary
item.description: In a sterile retail space, a store employee carefully slides a pair of Crocs onto a mannequin's feet. What happens next is pure magic: the rigid figure opens its eyes, blinks for the first time, stretches, and takes its first curious steps into the world. This is the opening of Crocs' new global campaign, ‘Wonderfully Unordinary,’ which launches nearly a decade after the brand's last narrative shift, ‘Come As You Are,’ launched in 2017. item.title: Oracle considers 30,000 layoffs to fund AI data centre
item.description: Oracle is considering cutting between 20,000 and 30,000 jobs and selling some business units as U.S. banks pull back from financing the company’s AI data-centre expansion, according to a research note by investment bank TD Cowen cited by CIO. The potential job cuts could free up between $8 billion and $10 billion in cash flow. item.title: WPP Media names Andrea Suarez as CEO for Latin America
item.description: WPP Media has appointed Andrea Suarez as Chief Executive Officer for Latin America. Suarez joins the agency from IPG Mediabrands, where she most recently served as Global Chief Executive Officer of UM Worldwide. She is expected to oversee the agency’s operations across Latin America as it expands its presence in the region. item.title: ZEE announces Sandeep Mehrotra as Chief Operating Officer, Advertisement Revenue
item.description: Zee Entertainment Enterprises Ltd. has appointed Sandeep Mehrotra as Chief Operating Officer - Advertisement Revenue, as per media reports. Mehrotra will oversee the company’s advertising revenue operations, with a focus on improving monetisation by aligning its linear television and digital businesses. item.title: WhatsApp tests paid subscription for additional features
item.description: WhatsApp is developing an optional premium subscription plan that would offer additional features to users, according to a report by WABetaInfo. The plan was spotted in the WhatsApp beta for Android version 2.26.4.8, which indicates that access to the subscription may initially be offered through a waitlist. item.title: Snapchat blocks 415,000 teen accounts in Australia
item.description: Snapchat has blocked or disabled about 415,000 accounts in Australia held by users under 16 since the country’s social media age restrictions took effect, while warning that some minors may still be bypassing age verification systems. The action follows Australia’s Social Media Minimum Age law, which came into force on December 10 and requires platforms including Snapchat, Meta, TikTok and YouTube to prevent users under 16 from holding accounts. item.title: Elon Musk's SpaceX acquires xAI, plans to build data centres in space
item.description: SpaceX has acquired AI company xAI, CEO Elon Musk announced in a memo, outlining plans to develop large-scale, space-based AI computing systems powered by solar energy. The acquisition would combine SpaceX’s launch capabilities, satellite networks and communications systems with xAI’s AI work. item.title: PHD secures global media AOR for Mandai Wildlife Group
item.description: Omnicom Media agency PHD has been appointed the global media agency on record for Mandai Wildlife Group, with responsibility across markets including Singapore, Australia, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Japan and South Korea. The account will be led strategically from Singapore. From January 2026, the agency will handle integrated media strategy, planning, buying, activation and performance optimisation across paid media channels.
